title: Late Return and the ProBuild Discount Rate on Ridgeline Tool Rental
content:
On Ridgeline Tool Rental, a late return lowers the ProBuild discount rate of the agreement.

> Late return takes points away: equipment returned two or more calendar days after the due-back date loses 1 point; equipment returned on the calendar day right after the due-back date loses half a point (0.5); equipment returned on or before the due-back date loses none.

The points are taken off the ProBuild discount rate of the agreement point for point, whatever the ProBuild tier's own rental discount percentage, and the ProBuild discount rate of the agreement never goes below zero.

The comparison is between calendar dates: the date part of the return time and the date part of the due-back time on the agreement. The hour of the return within a day does not count.

## Input, judgement, result

| Return date compared with the due-back date | Points taken away |
|---|---|
| same day or earlier | 0 |
| the next calendar day | 0.5 |
| two or more calendar days later | 1 |

## Hypothetical cases (due-back Tuesday 14 April at 17:00)

- Returned Tuesday 14 April at 21:30: on the due-back date; nothing is taken away.
- Returned Wednesday 15 April at 07:10: the calendar day right after; 0.5 is taken away.
- Returned Thursday 16 April at 08:00: two calendar days after; 1 point is taken away.

## The floor at zero (hypothetical)

A ProBuild Bronze member, whose tier percentage is 0, returns two days late with no points added: 0 less 1 would be below zero, so the ProBuild discount rate of the agreement is 0.
